subject: model calls inside the package
value: no file in the package may call a model or open a network connection; enforced by a test
author: contract:orchestraguard-v2
rationale: the one defensible sentence is that agreement is decided by comparison, never by a model — if authoring moves inside the package that stops being true

subject: cli flag for selecting a contract
author: contract:orchestraguard-v2
rationale: every loop command takes it, so it has to be the same word everywhere

subject: cli command that runs acceptance checks
author: contract:orchestraguard-v2
rationale: verify already means route verification in v0.1 and renaming it would break installed users

subject: how token figures are presented
value: every token figure is labelled an estimate and states its chars-per-token assumption
author: contract:orchestraguard-v2
rationale: the package measures bytes; calling bytes tokens would be the kind of unsourced number this project exists to avoid

subject: mcp tool name prefix for loop tools
value: no prefix; tool names are write_contract, bind_contract, brief_unit, fleet_plan, run_acceptance, generate_docs, cost_report
author: contract:orchestraguard-v2
rationale: the existing five tools carry no prefix, and mixing conventions inside one server is the drift this tool exists to catch
